amazon.closing_fee_notes: Amazon charges a per-unit closing/fixed fee in addition to the referral (%) fee for lower-priced items — factor it separately, not as part of the percentage.
prohibited_category_notes: Certain categories (medical devices, specific electronics) require category approval before listing
Counterfeit or trademark-infringing listings are aggressively delisted — verify brand rights before listing a branded-sounding product
listing_requirements: High-resolution main image on a pure white background
Accurate GST/HSN classification required at listing time
Brand Registry / A+ Content needed for richer listing content
amazon.return_policy_notes: Amazon's buyer-friendly return window (often 7-10 days, category-dependent) shifts real-world return risk onto the seller — estimate return_cost conservatively, not optimistically.
amazon.payment_cycle_notes: Typical settlement is 7-14 days post-delivery confirmation, category-dependent — verify the current cycle before modeling cash flow.

flipkart.closing_fee_notes: Similar tiered fee structure to Amazon — a slab-based collection fee applies at lower price points, separate from the commission percentage.
prohibited_category_notes: Some categories require Flipkart-specific quality certification before approval
Brand-restricted categories need an explicit brand NOC (No Objection Certificate)
listing_requirements: Listing Quality Score affects search ranking — complete specifications matter, not just images
flipkart.return_policy_notes: A comparably buyer-friendly return window to Amazon — estimate return risk conservatively, especially for fragile or apparel categories.
flipkart.payment_cycle_notes: Typical settlement is around 7-15 days post-delivery — verify the current cycle before modeling cash flow.

meesho.closing_fee_notes: Meesho's headline commission is comparatively low, but it has its own per-order fixed charges — verify the current fee slab rather than assuming near-zero cost.
prohibited_category_notes: Primarily a reseller-driven, value/fashion-focused marketplace — high-value electronics are less common and less competitive here
listing_requirements: Simpler listing process than Amazon/Flipkart, but catalog quality still affects reseller pickup rate
meesho.return_policy_notes: Return/exchange handling is typically reseller-mediated, which can extend effective resolution time compared to Amazon or Flipkart.
meesho.payment_cycle_notes: Settlement can lag Amazon/Flipkart — verify the current payout cycle before assuming a specific cash-flow timeline.
